agent_notes: The 70 days of Egyptian mourning (v. 3) are counted from Jacob's death and include the 40 days of embalming (Rashi, Radak: 40 for embalming + 30 for weeping), so the mourning is anchored on the death's START and the embalming runs inside it. Paced at walking speed: Goshen–Atad road (≈465 km) is ≈16 days on foot against 7 by chariot; I chose walking because the company is 'very great' and includes elders and a household, with margin 3 days toward the chariot pace. Pseudo-Jonathan's Esau episode at Hebron (v. 13) is not used.
